selection_policy: Require both lower medians and at least21 of31 paired wins against the prior selected compiler in each continuous post-JSON and whole-process interval.

failed_longer_cohort.cause: Disk exhausted during untimed duplicate output retention, after1344 captured invocations. Partial receipts and every recoverable output copy are retained; this incomplete cohort is not a headline comparison.
failed_longer_cohort.harness_change: Only post-exit evidence copies share immutable files; commands, generated code, source, counters and timing boundaries are unchanged.

limitations: Shared M3 development machine; these are local measurements, not cross-machine results.
Hardware instruction counts cover the continuous post-JSON interval across process threads. They are not generated-query-only counts.
Native PC observations are positions, not CPU-time shares or dynamic instruction attribution; waiting positions are explicit.
The new child-funding pass is phase-only and does not match the related query tree; no isolated attribution of the integration speedup to that pass is claimed.
Generated native code shrinks, while the complete executable and its host-runtime text grow. Requested heap, live heap, physical footprint and RSS are separately measured.
Rust parity remains unmet in both intervals. No green hosted-CI or merge claim.
